items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: He's a nice fella. Yeah. I haven't seen him in a long time. He used to call me.

ctx.x: Well, you don't remember Richard... Did... Does he have any family up there in uh... Donaldsonville there? Sure. A lot of them up there. Oh, my aunts and everything. Did they have any pictures of him when he was young? Which name got all the pictures? Lionel or...
Uh... I'm quite sure he got some. Uh... Let me get that book. Dick. Let me see if... Okay, we can start. Here we go.
Alright, let's see. We're talking about Richard L. Jones and the Lionel. Now, uh... And any more about Richard that you know? I guess we've covered about everything you know about him.
